page.overview:
What is Beetroot?

A beetroot is an edible item obtained from beetroot crops that can be used as a crafting or dye ingredient.

Beetroots are obtained from harvesting a fully grown crop block, which drops 1 beetroot and 1-4 seeds ( seeds per plant harvested on average). Seed yield can be increased using a tool enchanted with Fortune, with Fortune III harvesting an average of seeds per plant.

These crops can be found growing in villages or can be grown from planted beetroot seeds.

A beetroot can be eaten to restore hunger and 1.2 hunger saturation. Six beetroots can be crafted into beetroot soup, which restores six times the hunger and saturation of a single beetroot.
